summary: Green Dot Corporation filed an 8-K providing an update on its pending transaction with CommerceOne Financial Corporation. The complex deal involves two initial mergers where wholly owned subsidiaries of New CommerceOne merge with CommerceOne and Green Dot, followed by a merger of CommerceOne into New CommerceOne. Additionally, Green Dot will convert to an LLC, distribute its bank subsidiary to a CommerceOne sub, and OpCo (affiliated with Smith Ventures) will acquire Green Dot's non-bank fintech assets. A special stockholder meeting is set for June 23, 2026. No specific price, premium, or advisors were disclosed. Watch for stockholder approval and regulatory clearance.
